result.title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
result.comment: 19 pages including references and appendices, 5 figures
result.summary: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FlexFloor 系统，在 MoE 模型的同步响应生成阶段联合调整响应调度与工作节点活跃组，使完成本地生成的工作节点可提前释放资源，同时保留在途响应所需的专家计算，从而提升 RL 后训练 rollout 吞吐。
